name: Message
summary: Single-turn bubble in an AI conversation. Renders user / assistant / system / tool roles with role-appropriate alignment, surface treatment, and accessibility hooks. Mirrors Vercel AI Elements `Message` verbatim; `MessageContent` is the body slot.

from.description: Speaker role. Drives alignment (user right, assistant left), surface treatment, and announce-via-aria behavior.

id.description: Stable id for the message. Used as React key in long threads + as anchor target for InlineCitation jumps.

children.description: MessageContent + optional MessageResponse + Reasoning + Tool + Sources + Actions slots.

keyboard: Tab — navigate between Actions strip buttons below message
wcag: 1.3.1 Info and Relationships — role=article semantically scopes each turn for assistive tech.
1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) — text inherits Lumen body tokens which clear 4.5:1 against surface.raised + tint-accent.
2.1.1 Keyboard — Tab reaches every Actions button in source order; no keyboard trap.
2.4.6 Headings and Labels — aria-label is conditional ('You said: ...' / 'Assistant said: ...').
rules: Assistant messages flow through Conversation's aria-live=polite announcer.
System messages use aria-live=assertive (rare; reserve for critical state).
aria-label is conditional: 'You said: ...' for user, 'Assistant said: ...' for assistant.

do: ALWAYS pair user messages with right-alignment + neutral surface; assistant messages with left-alignment + tint-accent surface for active streaming, neutral when complete.
ALWAYS forward the id for InlineCitation anchor jumps.
dont: NEVER render a user bubble with Spring Green chrome. The accent is for assistant action moments only.
NEVER bake the model name into Message. Models live in PromptInputSelect / LumenAIProvider context.
NEVER drop the from prop. Without it, alignment + ARIA semantics break.
